items.title: Are Big Tech stock buybacks officially dead?
items.summary: As hyperscalers Alphabet  (GOOGL, GOOG), Amazon (AMZN), Meta (META), and Microsoft  (MSFT) pour billions into AI data centers, stock buybacks appear to be taking a back seat. Repurchases reportedly fell to $4.4 billion in the third quarter, a 90% drop from previous quarters. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor and Sozzi Unleashed host Brian Sozzi examines whether Big Tech's massive AI spending spree is coming at the expense of shareholder returns. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor and host Sozzi Unleashed takes a closer look.

items.title: China’s Moonshot AI seeks Nvidia Blackwell access in Europe, CNBC reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- Chinese artificial intelligence startup Moonshot AI has explored leasing data center capacity in Europe to secure remote access to NVIDIA Corporation's (NASDAQ:NVDA) advanced Blackwell processors, according to a report from CNBC. The move highlights how Chinese developers are increasingly looking beyond domestic borders to bypass tightening U.S. export restrictions on cutting-edge silicon.

items.title: Port Announces PortCon - the First AI Software Factory Summit
items.summary: Port, the open AI Software Factory platform, today announced The AI Software Factory Summit, taking place Nov. 17-18, 2026 at SHACK15 in San Francisco. The event features AI software factory use cases and insights from leading technology companies, including NVIDIA, GitHub, SpaceX, Uber and Expedia. Attendees will see how these teams run AI in production and learn what has worked, what hasn't, and how to build and scale their own factories.
